task: Core 1186 U07: revalidate Pro-only Office support_reply entitlement at worker send time under downgrade revocation and retry while preserving Alap transactional messages

assuranceCeiling.rationale: An asynchronous service-role send can cross a Pro-to-Alap transition; use the canonical current entitlement resolver, bounded explicit blocking, no provider send on denied/unknown, and both positive and negative regression evidence. Do not claim atomicity with external provider.

acceptanceCriteria: Worker uses getFeatureEntitlementDecision(instanceId,officeCommunicationAdvanced) for support_reply at every claimed-send attempt, including retries, after claim identity/template/purpose validation.
Decision enabled false (plan boundary, revocation or expiry) records permanent fail_communication_job_v2 with retry=false, increases blocked count, and skips provider.send.
Unverifiable/null decision or resolver failure never sends; existing bounded retry handles temporary lookup failure and eventually fails after retry budget.
Enforcement occurs before Office reply mailbox and attachments are loaded and before provider.send; record tenant-scoped job claim evidence.
Other transactional/marketing messages do not enter Office Pro gate and retain suppression and consent policies.
Negative tests distinguish Office denial, unknown entitlement and standard Alap communication, and preserve retry evidence.
Plan Before Code, Reference/Implementation Sync, Knowledge/Atlas, replay, Release Risk, exact-head CI, Completion Truth and lifecycle closure must all PASS; no gate waiver.
invariants: The only Office send authorization feature is the existing officeCommunicationAdvanced canonical entitlement decision; no second controller or copied catalog list.
Existing tenant mismatch, provider template purpose, suppression/consent checks and claim token completion remain unchanged.
No queries or sends for any other tenant in a claimed instance loop; query uses current instanceId.
No alteration of normal Alap transactional/marketing capability behavior, including order confirmation and stock_available jobs.
forbiddenStates: A queued support_reply send proceeds solely because it was authorized when enqueued or appears to be transactional.
A revoked or plan-downgraded tenant gets an Office reply or its attachment sent by the service-role worker.
An entitlement resolver read failure defaults to enabled or permits provider.send.
Any blanket advanced Office gate blocks all standard Alap customer email jobs.
Worker claim failure is swallowed without durable fail_communication_job_v2 evidence.
U07 claims to solve all persistent-data/transition risks or mark #1186 DONE.

failureModes: Pro tenant queues support_reply then downgrades to Alap before claim
Entitlement row revoked or expired after enqueue but before provider send
Admin service role bypasses Next.js layout and prior Server Action authorization
Unknown or null entitlement caused by missing row or database outage
Provider failure after passing current Pro entitlement still follows existing retry handling
Mixed tenant queue job triggers tenant identity mismatch
Normal Alap order confirmation incorrectly classified as Office
Read check passes but plan revoked in post-query race before external send
edgeCases: support_reply always follows canonical current feature decision regardless of transactional purpose
Unknown decision never treated as allowed
Plan-boundary revoked returns explicit disabled decision
Retry-attempt count 4 permits a transient recheck; 5 exhausts current bounded retries
No transient Office error accidentally becomes permanent merely because message starts OFFICE_
Ordinary marketing messages retain consent checks
Office attachment not loaded on blocked job
External provider send is an irreversible side-effect, no imaginary atomic guarantee

semanticExecutionRoute.request: Core 1186 U07: revalidate Pro-only Office support_reply entitlement at worker send time under downgrade revocation and retry while preserving Alap transactional messages

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The asynchronous service-role communication worker claims and sends queued support_reply Office messages after enqueue-time authorization, without rechecking the current tenant Pro-only officeCommunicationAdvanced entitlement at send time. Alap downgrade, revocation, stale grants or retries could still release the email and office attachment payload. Preserve all normal Alap transactional/marketing customer messages.
observableOutcomes: A claimed support_reply job must prove the current tenant officeCommunicationAdvanced Pro entitlement before reading its Office reply mailbox or attachments and before calling provider.send.
An explicitly revoked, downgraded, expired or plan-boundary denied Office entitlement is a durable blocked job with fail_communication_job_v2 evidence (retry false), not sent.
Null, missing or temporarily unavailable entitlement proof fails closed without sending and retries only within the bounded existing claim retry policy.
Non-support_reply transactional/marketing/stock-notification jobs preserve existing send, consent, suppression and suppression-error retry semantics.
unresolvedRisks: Already accepted provider sends cannot be recalled by an entitlement change racing after the send-time authorization query; avoid overclaiming atomic provider + DB transaction.
The service-role worker needs a canonical tenant-scoped entitlement resolver, never trusting stale queued feature rows or caller flags.
A missing entitlement candidate and database read failure both resolve null; the bounded retry policy must prevent sending while those states remain unresolved.

in: Bounded send-time Pro entitlement validation in src/lib/communication/worker.ts only for support_reply
Negative downgrade/revocation and null-proof retry contract tests
Alap normal commerce customer email regression assertions
out: Rearchitect communication worker queue or claim/recovery SQL
Modify Supabase migrations, RLS, entitlements or organization data
Change email template/provider, reader UI, Team Chat, API attachment routes
Mark #1186 completely DONE without persistent-data/transition proof
